rebind_candidates.anchor_excerpt: Although Metzinger puts the concept of “earlier processing states” into the conceptual context of phenomenal transparency, attentional availability, and phenomenal opacity, he leaves open their exact empirical characterization. $ ^{12} $ It seems as if we have no direct access to them as such, and their existence can be only inferred and hypothetically assumed on an indirect basis. However, this is all that he tells us about them. He neither specifies any empirical processes nor makes any hypothetical assumptions by at least indirectly inferring their possible empirical features and characteristics.
